location_exception_reason: Tensile structure design services are sold as engineering-led turnkey projects to national and regional clients (architects, developers, government agencies); location in the title does not change the service offering itself. Buyers filter by service capability (design, FEA, membrane expertise, installation supervision), not by seller geography. GI or regional-origin exemptions do not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Tensile structure design is inherently a service-delivery model where the business relationship (design-build partnership, design-only consulting, design-fabrication-installation turnkey) defines the scope and value proposition. Titles such 'Tensile Structure Design Service', 'Design-Build Tensile Structure Partner', or 'Turnkey Tensile Structure Installation' communicate the engagement model to architects and developers; removing the service/partnership framing leaves the title incomplete and ambiguous about whether the seller offers design, fabrication, installation, or all three.
